package fixture

type cleaner struct{}

func (c *cleaner) cleanup() {}

type pkgT struct{}

func (pkgT) Func() {}

func plain() {}

func cases() {
	var c cleaner
	go c.cleanup()            // DETECT selector (recv.method)
	go pkg.Func()             // DETECT selector (pkg.Func)
	go func() { plain() }()   // DETECT func
	go plain()                // DETECT call (identifier)

	defer c.cleanup()         // IGNORE defer
	_ = "go c.cleanup()"      // IGNORE string literal
	_ = `go plain()`          // IGNORE raw string literal
	// go c.cleanup()         // IGNORE comment
}
